Relying on that communication, I submitted the sign-off to execute the push at [Time]. I did not conduct an independent review of the underlying ledgers prior to submission."

2. **Omission of policy claims:** Claiming "I had no reason to check" asserts a procedural standard. If internal audit or compliance shows that your role requires independent verification, that claim will be contradicted by documentation.
3. **Accountability:** Stating clearly that you relied on AP's confirmation places the communication on the record, while acknowledging the lack of ledger review prevents the appearance of concealing the gap.
